title: Marx and Engels Faced West - Quick Summary
items: **The monument opened in April 1986** as a late GDR statement in the centre of East Berlin.

**The west-facing story comes from movement, not a clean original plan:** U5 construction shifted and turned the figures 180 degrees in 2010. In 2022 they went back to their 1986 place and face east toward the TV Tower again.
**The joke stuck because it is perfect Berlin:** Marx and Engels were said to be looking at capitalism at last.
**The statues survived reunification** because Berlin kept them as visible evidence, not as instruction.
**Since July 2025 a building fence closes the monument** while the Rathaus- and Marx-Engels-Forum is rebuilt (checked on 6 October 2026).
